about_the_game:
As a leading avatar maker and virtual chat app, MASS lets you express your unique style. Dress your character in fashionable, cute, and kawaii outfits, design your dream home, and even adopt virtual pets. It’s the perfect place for social gaming, roleplay, and meeting new friends.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • Create Your 3D Avatar: Be whoever you want to be! Enjoy extensive customization for your avatar’s face, hair, and clothes.

  • Social Chat & Make Friends: Connect with a global community through video chat and text chat. Hang out and make new friends in real-time.

  • Play Games Together: Join a variety of multiplayer games—from obstacle courses to fashion contests and roleplay adventures.

  • Explore Virtual Worlds: Discover ever-expanding spaces, from bustling city streets to serene cherry blossom gardens.

  • Express Your Style: Dress up in thousands of fashion items. Customize your room and show off your creativity.

  • Adopt Cute Pets: Choose from cats, dogs, and more! Take care of your virtual pets, and they’ll love you forever.

MASS is more than just an app—it’s your gateway to a social universe where you can play, chat, and create without limits.

Download MASS: 3D Avatar & Virtual World Chat today and join the fun!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur 或更高
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 或 Apple M1（最低）
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Apple M1 内置GPU
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura 或更高
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 或 Intel Core i5 四核及以上
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU 或独立显卡（AMD/Intel Iris Xe）
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

name: MASS : 3D Create & Play

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 或同等性能
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X（支持 DirectX 11） DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
